newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Franklin County, Tenn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Franklin County, Tenn..

text.p: Notice is hereby given that the County Executive of Franklin County, Tennessee (the County'') will receive sealed bids only for the purchase of the County's $5,000,000 SCHOOL BONDS, SERIES 1996 and $5,000,000 SCHOOLBONDS, SERIES 1997 (the Series 1996 School Bonds'' and the Series 1997 School Bonds ''respectively and collectively the School Bonds'') and $4,000,000 GENERAL OBLIGATION JAIL BONDS, SERIES 1997 (the Jail Bonds'') (collectively the
on an all or none basis, until 10:00 a.m., C.S.T., on

(or at such later time and date announced at least forty- eight hours in advance via Munifacts) at the Franklin County Executive's office in Winchester, Tennessee, at a rate or rates not exceeding seven percent (7.00%) per annum. The Bonds will be dated December 1, 1996 and will mature on March 1 in the years 1997 through 2016, inclusive. No bid will be considered for less than ninety-eight and three- quarters percent (98.75%) of par and accrued interest. Unless all bids are rejected, the County Executive will award the Bonds on the sale date to the bidder whose bid results in the lowest true interest rate on the Bonds. The Bonds are callable March 1, 2005 and thereafter as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The printed Bonds and approving opinion of Bass, Berry & Sims PLC, Knoxville, Tennessee will be furnished at the expense of the County. Additional information, including the PRELIMINARY OFFICIAL STATEMENT in near final form and the Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at the County Executive's Office in Winchester, Tennessee 37398, or from Cumberland Securities, Division of Morgan Keegan & Company, Inc., 530 South Gay Street - Suite 800, Knoxville, Tennessee 37902, Telephone: 423-637-1131.
